# Analyze S6 peak windows and my missed opportunities
import pandas as pd

trips = tables['trips']
s6_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == 6].copy()

# Group by day and class to see daily fleet averages
daily_fleet = s6_trips.groupby(['fish_date_doy', 'cls']).agg({
    'yt': 'sum',
    'anglers': 'sum'
}).reset_index()
daily_fleet['yt_per_angler'] = daily_fleet['yt'] / (daily_fleet['anglers'] + 0.1)
daily_fleet = daily_fleet.sort_values('fish_date_doy')

# Find the days when each class peaked
three_quarter = daily_fleet[daily_fleet['cls'] == 'three_quarter'].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False).head(10)
overnight = daily_fleet[daily_fleet['cls'] == 'overnight'].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False).head(10)
day_1_5 = daily_fleet[daily_fleet['cls'] == 'day_1_5'].sort_values('yt_per_angler', ascending=False).head(10)

print("=== S6 THREE_QUARTER TOP 10 DAYS ===")
print(three_quarter[['fish_date_doy', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

print("\n=== S6 OVERNIGHT TOP 10 DAYS ===")
print(overnight[['fish_date_doy', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

print("\n=== S6 DAY_1_5 TOP 10 DAYS ===")
print(day_1_5[['fish_date_doy', 'yt_per_angler']].to_string())

# Identify my booking window and what I missed
print("\n=== MY BOOKINGS (from results.json) ===")
my_days = [94, 95, 101, 102, 108, 115, 122]
for day in my_days:
    day_data = daily_fleet[daily_fleet['fish_date_doy'] == day]
    print(f"d{day}: {day_data.to_string(index=False)}")

# Compare S2 and S6 to see if late DAY_1_5 peaks are reliable
trips = tables['trips']

for season in [2, 6]:
    s_trips = trips[trips['fish_date_season'] == season]
    
    # Focus on DAY_1_5
    day_1_5 = s_trips[s_trips['cls'] == 'day_1_5'].groupby('fish_date_doy').agg({
        'yt': 'sum',
        'anglers': 'sum'
    }).reset_index()
    day_1_5['yt_pa'] = day_1_5['yt'] / (day_1_5['anglers'] + 0.1)
    day_1_5 = day_1_5.sort_values('fish_date_doy')
    
    # Find peaks
    day_1_5['peak_window'] = pd.cut(day_1_5['fish_date_doy'], 
                                     bins=[0, 90, 150, 220, 365], 
                                     labels=['Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Late'])
    
    print(f"\n=== SEASON {season} DAY_1_5 BY WINDOW ===")
    for window in ['Spring', 'Summer', 'Fall', 'Late']:
        w_data = day_1_5[day_1_5['peak_window'] == window]
        if len(w_data) > 0:
            print(f"{window}: avg {w_data['yt_pa'].mean():.2f}, max {w_data['yt_pa'].max():.2f}, days {len(w_data)}")
    
    print(f"\nTop 5 DAY_1_5 days S{season}:")
    print(day_1_5.nlargest(5, 'yt_pa')[['fish_date_doy', 'yt_pa']].to_string(index=False))

# Also check if climate index (ONI) is available
climate = tables['climate']
oni_s2_s6 = climate[climate['index_id'] == 'oni'].copy()
print(f"\n=== ONI INDEX ===")
print(oni_s2_s6[['avail_season', 'avail_doy', 'value']].head(20).to_string(index=False))
